Your first visit

What to know before you arrive.

How do I book?

Choose a category on this page or go straight to the booking page, pick a service, and choose a time. You can also call or text (301) 591-6340.

How do I choose a service?

Waxing appointments depend on when you were last waxed here: first visit, within 4 to 6 weeks, or longer. Facials are chosen after a free consultation based on your skin type and needs. If you are unsure, call or text and the team will help you pick.

Where do I park and where do I arrive?

The spa is at 13217 Executive Park Terrace, Germantown, MD 20874. There is plenty of parking at the building. [Exact lot and entrance details to be confirmed with the owner.] Get directions.

How should I prepare?

For waxing: gently exfoliate the area 24 hours before, avoid oils or lotions the day of, and wear loose, comfortable clothing. For wellness services, preparation instructions come from the provider after your consultation, so please ask the team rather than guess.

What if I need to cancel or reschedule?

[Cancellation and rescheduling policy — to be confirmed with the owner.] Until then, please call or text the spa.

How do I contact the spa?

Call or text (301) 591-6340, or send a callback request below.
